description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class `AbstractRegistrationService` which implements common registration assertion logic for devices within the Eclipse Hono framework. It provides methods for asserting registration, retrieving device info, checking authorization, and handling registration payloads, with hooks for subclasses to customize device retrieval and validation.

classes.name: AbstractRegistrationService
classes.description: An abstract base class implementing common registration assertion logic, which subclasses must extend to provide device data retrieval.

methods.name: assertRegistration
methods.description: Asserts device registration status; uses getDevice to retrieve info and then checks if device is enabled.

methods.name: assertRegistration
methods.description: Overloaded method with default span implementation; calls the detailed version.

methods.name: assertRegistration
methods.description: Claims registration by device ID and tenant; fetches device info and constructs success or failure result.

methods.name: assertRegistration
methods.description: Claims registration considering gateway authorization; retrieves info for device and gateway and checks authorization.

methods.name: isGatewayAuthorized
methods.description: Default implementation checking if gateway ID matches the 'via' property in device data.

methods.name: createSuccessfulRegistrationResult
methods.description: Creates a successful registration result with payload and cache directive.

methods.name: getAssertionPayload
methods.description: Generates the payload of the registration assertion message, including device ID, supported gateways, and defaults.

methods.name: isGatewaySupportedForDevice
methods.description: Determines if a gateway may act on behalf of the device based on 'via' property.

methods.name: isDeviceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if device registration result indicates device is enabled.

methods.name: isDeviceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if device data JSON indicates device is enabled; default true.

methods.name: getRegistrationAssertionCacheDirective
methods.description: Provides cache directive for registration assertions; default max age.

methods.name: getSupportedGatewaysForDevice
methods.description: Retrieves list of gateways supported for device, based on 'via' property.
